

```{r setup}
# packages required for Visium HD
# install.packages("hdf5r")
# install.packages("arrow")
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
```

```{r load data}
localdir <- here("data","spaceranger", "LM13969")
visium_objs <- list()
for (sample in list.files(path=localdir)) {
  object <- Load10X_Spatial(data.dir = here(localdir,sample,"outs"), bin.size = c(2, 8, 16))
  Assays(object)
  DefaultAssay(object) <- "Spatial.008um"
  visium_objs[[sample]] <- object
}

```
